document.text:
Visitor desk procedures

Visitors must wear badges, except infants. Guides may lend maps.

When a library card was lost more than a month ago and remains unreported, staff must request a replacement. If travel is imminent, a temporary pass may be issued while that replacement is pending.

When a lost library card is found and returned, staff should cancel its replacement request.

Employees and contractors may enter the reading room with either a day pass or a membership card.

The reading room contains two windows.

unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must wear badges, except infants.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies when a library card was lost more than a month ago and remains unreported.
unit_attributes.statement: When a library card was lost more than a month ago and remains unreported, staff must request a replacement.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies when a library card was lost more than a month ago, remains unreported, and a replacement request is pending.
unit_attributes.statement: When a library card was lost more than a month ago and remains unreported, if travel is imminent, a temporary pass may be issued while that replacement is pending.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies when a lost library card is found and returned.
unit_attributes.statement: When a lost library card is found and returned, staff should cancel its replacement request.

unit_attributes.choice_text: Entry is permitted with either a day pass or a membership card as independently sufficient options.
unit_attributes.statement: Employees and contractors may enter the reading room with either a day pass or a membership card.
